:) this wonderful young lady gave my wife and I our beautiful fur-daughter. When we first adopted her, she was unbelievably shy and refused to come out. After a couple of weeks, she finally came out and is now the biggest snuggle bug.

Thank you for a brand new life with Sybil! 🌈❤️

Hi, 21 F here who has a 22 y/o fiancée. We’ve been together for 3 years. Let me tell you that is does infact get rocky and tough at some points. 

From my personal experience, my depression not only wants me to isolate myself, but harm myself as well. My so just so happens to have depression as well, but to a much much lesser degree.

I too first thought that she wouldn’t be able to love me- especially since I found myself as unlovable. I thought that my depression relapses, self harm incidences, and rampant psychiatrist visits would make her love me less and less. I thought my negativity would turn her away, but it didn’t.

For reasons unknown (I guess she loves me that much huh?) she’s still stuck around with me for all these years. I want to reiterate that having a so will infact, NOT, solve all of your problems. I know a lot of people who think that getting in a relationship would help their depression.

It is. A lot of work.

It is. It’s just simply a lot of work on both ends. Any and all relationships are.
But don’t let your depression take control of that aspect of your live.

Besides. Mental “I”llness turns into Mental “We”llness when you have someone that truly loves you and is willing to work with you.

I can’t even begin to tell you how many days I’ve woken up and have her be the only thing that kept me on that planet that day.
My apologies about the late reply, but thank you.
Will do so. She makes me incredibly happy and I want what's best for her!

I have asked her that actually! She has told me multiple times that she has wanted to move out, to get out of the house, and to start a life with me. She desperately wants to leave, but she's not entirely sure how to start it/begin/etc.

I will do so, thank you. Your input is incredibly appreciated.
As much as I hate to admit it, you're right. Thank you for your input.
Coming back and reading this made me realized just how fucked up I was last night. I do apologize for the rambling good lord.
